doc: The environment function an atom denotes (docs/CLAUSE_DESIGN.md): its name marks each hole with the position of the argument it reads, and its arguments are the distinct terms the holes read, in order of first appearance. Read by the Python tests (csdfbmc/tests/test_atoms.py) and the Go ones (csdf/clause/function_test.go). The refused cases are what csdfbmc does not read yet; Go reads paths and values after the step.

named.case: a $name hole and the space that ends it
named.name: $_0 が 十分

named.case: two holes, the first read again
named.text: $a と $b と $a が 等しい
named.name: $_0 と $_1 と $_0 が 等しい

named.case: two holes, the second read again
named.text: $a と $b と $b が 等しい
named.name: $_0 と $_1 と $_1 が 等しい

named.case: a hole before text that cannot continue a name
a ${name} hole is the same hole
named.name: $_0 が 十分
